text.p: Arnold Industries Inc said on Tuesday that it has delayed its acquisition of Motor Cargo Industries, a Salt Lake City based less-than-truckload carrier.
The tentative agreement was anticipated to close September 30, 1996.
Both companies are cooperating in the performance of due diligence and are negotiating terms of the agreement, Arnold said.
Closing may be delayed to the end of the year, Arnold Industries said.
The reason why the deal between Arnold Industries and Motor Cargo was delayed was not immediately available.
Arnold Industries treasurer Ron Walborn said the companies were "a little optimistic" about getting the deal closed by September 30.
The companies have not completed due diligence and also Arnold Industries wanted union contracts resolved at two terminals before the purchase was made, Walborn said.
